scope: placement-only comparison of compiler-generated TinyStories-1M DDR3/PCIe integration variants
purpose: separate diagnostic trace-CSR timing cost from the remaining compiler/DDR implementation cost

common.acceptance_status: diagnostic only; no FASM or hardware claim

variants.name: trace_csr_elided_no_tmdriv
variants.route_result: router2 did not emit FASM in the bounded diagnostic

variants.name: trace_csr_elided_lutram
variants.route_result: router2 did not emit FASM in the bounded diagnostic

finding: Eliding diagnostic trace CSR logic reduces the PCIe-user-to-rowstream delay from 19.42 ns to 5.86--6.58 ns and raises PCIe timing to 55.76--65.79 MHz, but rowstream remains about 39 MHz versus the required 83.33 MHz. The remaining timing blocker is therefore not explained by the trace CSR alone; it is in the compiler/DDR-side implementation and/or its placement. No RTL change is authorized by this comparison.
